people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”
translations.bsb: So David asked him, “Why were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”
translations.kjv: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD'S anointed?
translations.asv: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to put forth thy hand to destroy Jehovah's anointed?
